description: Defines classes and structures related to OpenGL framebuffer objects, including Framebuffer and FramebufferState, with methods for managing attachments, state, and validation within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: FramebufferState
classes.description: Represents the state of an OpenGL framebuffer, including attachments, dimensions, and configuration.

classes.name: Framebuffer
classes.description: Represents an OpenGL framebuffer object, managing attachments, state validation, and operations.

methods.name: checkStatus
methods.description: Checks if the framebuffer is complete and ready for rendering.

methods.name: getImplementation
methods.description: Returns the underlying implementation object for the framebuffer.

methods.name: setAttachment
methods.description: Sets an attachment (texture or renderbuffer) to the framebuffer.

methods.name: detachTexture
methods.description: Detaches a texture from the framebuffer.

methods.name: detachRenderbuffer
methods.description: Detaches a renderbuffer from the framebuffer.
